subject.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to file consent upload requests

question: Should this PR wait for and reuse the shared abortable timeout contract from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104288, or should this branch establish that contract first?
rationale: The correct timeout behavior is established, but two open branches touch the same shared owner and maintainers must choose a conflict-free landing order.

options.title: Land shared owner first
options.body: Land or adopt the related request-timeout extension, then update this PR to consume it without introducing parallel policy.

options.title: Let this PR establish it
options.body: Move this branch's abort logic into request-timeout.ts and coordinate the related PR to consume the resulting shared contract.

options.title: Accept temporary duplication
options.body: Merge the file-local helper only with an explicit immediate consolidation plan and ownership of the upgrade risk.

recommendation.title: Land shared owner first
recommendation.body: Land or adopt the related request-timeout extension, then update this PR to consume it without introducing parallel policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work established the current shared timeout owner that both branches need to extend consistently.
